preconditions.description: The number of glades n must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n for xi, yi in trails)
preconditions.description: Each trail must connect glades within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' if is_eulerian(n, trails) else stdout == str(min_trails_to_add(n, trails))
postconditions.description: If the walk is possible without adding extra trails, output 0; otherwise, output the minimum number of trails needed.
